heading: Mathematical Physics & Computational Engineering
summary: Notes and derivations connecting mathematics, physics, numerical solvers, and engineering applications—from linear algebra and PDEs down to semiconductors, robotics, multiphysics manufacturing, materials simulation, and medical imaging. Hover or click any card to trace what it depends on and where it is used, or open the linked notes and Python experiments.
note: Labels are in Chinese. Reading progress is saved locally in your browser and shared with the full site.
